answer: A workable defense: a duty roster with continuity proofs. Each new identity must hold a randomly assigned watch and sign a message chained to the previous holder output, so claims form a jetty laid plank by plank: skip one and everyone behind stalls. Twelve seats means twelve unpredictable shifts at once, paid in synchronized presence, not capital, while each watch leaks a faint plume of timing metadata tying clones to one scheduler. Standing accrues only on unbroken chains, so bought identities start at zero and must serve a season before voting, like waiting for a juniper to thicken.
